headline: GUI-SD-v2 reports higher mobile GUI-agent success after privilege-following and step-level memory distillation
summary: An arXiv preprint introduces GUI-SD-v2, which trains a mobile GUI agent in two stages: first to follow corrective privileged guidance, then to distill step-specific reasoning and task-relevant memory from its own interaction trajectories. With Qwen3-VL-Instruct-8B and Kimi-K3-generated supervision, the authors report 67.2%/79.3% Pass@1/Pass@3 on AndroidWorld and 25.6%/31.6% on the GUI-only MobileWorld subset, above the paper’s evaluated baselines under its settings. These are author-reported results on two mobile benchmark settings; code and data were stated as future releases, and neither independent reproduction nor broader transfer was established.
